latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image to Video King 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly convert uploaded still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) into smooth animated videos with AI-powered motion effects.
- Simple workflow: upload, describe your vision, and receive a 1080p MP4 within 30–60 seconds.
- No complex editing tools required; handles session, token, and cloud rendering automatically.
- Credit and export management included; clear error handling and workflow feedback.
- Ideal for content creators and marketers seeking fast dynamic video creation from static photos.
